blocks.html: Millburn Township has a lot going on beneath its quiet suburban surface. blocks.title: Paper Mill Playhouse
blocks.html: Paper Mill Playhouse is one of the most respected regional theaters in the country, and it happens to be right in Millburn's backyard. A recipient of the Regional Theatre Tony Award, Paper Mill has long been a launching pad for new American musical theater, with a track record of productions that have gone on to Broadway. The venue sits at 22 Brookside Drive and draws audiences from across the region for its consistently high-caliber programming.

blocks.title: Taylor Park
blocks.html: Taylor Park is one of Millburn's most beloved public spaces, a 16-acre green anchor in the heart of downtown. Designed by the renowned landscape architecture firm Brinley & Holbrook and dedicated in 1924, the park features ball fields, a pond, tennis and basketball courts, a walking path, and the Bauer Community Center. The Rahway River runs through the grounds, adding a natural, unhurried quality that draws locals back again and again.

blocks.title: Cora Hartshorn Arboretum & Bird Sanctuary
blocks.html: Tucked into the Short Hills section of Millburn, the Cora Hartshorn Arboretum is a 16-acre historic woodland and bird sanctuary with hiking trails and environmental education programs for all ages. The arboretum is home to more than 150 species of native wildflowers and a restored forest habitat where native trees, plants, and wildlife all coexist. It's one of the more quietly remarkable natural spaces in the region.

blocks.title: The Mall at Short Hills
blocks.html: The Mall at Short Hills is one of New Jersey's premier luxury shopping destinations, with more than 150 stores and restaurants under one roof. Home to over 50 brands exclusive to the state, the center has long been a top retail destination in the northeastern United States. The mix spans designer labels, contemporary favorites, dining options, and premium home and beauty brands.

blocks.title: Millburn Standard
blocks.html: Millburn Standard on Main Street is a full-service restaurant and bar with something for every kind of night out. The menu leans into elevated American cuisine with rotating seasonal features, craft cocktails, an extensive beer selection, and a late-night kitchen that runs until midnight every day of the week. The atmosphere shifts easily from lively and social to warm and intimate, depending on where you settle in.

The menu covers tacos, birria, fajitas, quesadillas, and the restaurant's signature homemade guacamole, with a warm, vibrant atmosphere to match. It's the kind of neighborhood spot that earns regulars fast.

items.q: What’s the minimum age for cannabis delivery in Millburn?
items.a_html: You must be 21 or older to place a delivery order with Lady L. New Jersey's adult-use cannabis laws apply to every transaction. Age is verified during account setup, and your driver will confirm your ID at the door before completing the handoff.

items.q: What kind of ID do I need for a Lady L delivery?
items.a_html: Any valid government-issued photo ID will do, including driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports. Out-of-state IDs are welcome. Your ID must be uploaded to your Lady L account before you can place your first order, and you'll need the physical ID ready when your driver arrives.

items.q: Is a medical cannabis card required to receive delivery in Millburn?
items.a_html: No medical card is necessary. Lady L operates as an adult-use dispensary, so any customer 21 or older can place a delivery order. All you need is a valid ID and a confirmed Lady L account.

items.q: How much cannabis can I order in a single Millburn delivery?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law allows us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams (1 ounce) of usable cannabis per transaction. Here's how that breaks down:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes will I pay on a Millburn cannabis delivery order?
items.a_html: Adult-use cannabis purchases in New Jersey carry a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where applicable, and a $2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). These apply to delivery orders just as they do to in-store purchases. All applicable charges are itemized at checkout before you confirm.
